The '''razor mushroom''' was a type of [[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]] that grew on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="Traitor">{{DoD|The Traitor's Gambit}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The razor mushroom appeared in "[[The Traitor's Gambit]]," a [[2007]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Rodney Thompson]] as part of the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Traitor" />
